mentions.name: AI Copilot for Project Management
mentions.description: An AI copilot for project management that automates the tedium of managing work across tools, including status updates, task updates, and project docs.
mentions.problem: PMs, or unwilling but forced EMs, face tedious manual work to manage their projects across tools, such as writing status updates, updating tasks, and maintaining project docs.
mentions.audience: Project managers and engineering managers who have to manage work across tools
mentions.source_excerpt:
CoPilot for Project Management, trying to automate a lot of the tedium either PMs or unwilling, but forced EMs do to manage their work across tools: status updates, task updates, project docs, etc.
